notes.title: Redux Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I have been working for a long time on Bottle: Pilgrim's enhancements. Today I have released a major update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30942043/9538e34751d28ca52c1c4633411b459fe8d6889e.jpg

The game looks, sounds, and plays much better than the original version now. I won't write them down one by one here; if you want to know more about the changes, head over to the link below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/735350/discussions/0/3002173313622227882/

This is a free major update of one of your favorite games. Even its name has changed, now it is Bottle: Pilgrim Redux.
If there was something weak for you in the previous version, why don't you give it another try now? It's much better in many aspects with the new update.

With love and respect,
Tonguç

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
It's been almost 3 years since the release of Bottle: Pilgrim... and today I have updated it, making it easier to find your way around the snow level!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30942043/e0f1b6a19210c336977a649c5178e584ab1feb42.png

With the additional hint of footprints in the snow and ice, you won't get so lost locating the branches in order to progress. So anyone who's been held back by that particular level can now complete the story and see how it resolves.

Enjoy!
Tonguç
